_note: Hex values WITHOUT the leading # (so they can drop into docx/CSS configs that accept either form).

lightGray.name: Secondary (Light Gray)
lightGray.use: Dividers, borders, subtle backgrounds, table headers

accent.name: Secondary (Orange)
accent.use: ONLY accent color. Use for: section underlines, key callouts, link color, logo accent, CTA emphasis, brand moments. Use sparingly — orange is the entire brand voice.

semantic._note: This semantic block is a drop-in 'brand' override for the seo-report-formatter skill and other doc generators that use the same key names. It maps Macronimous's grayscale-plus-orange palette into the generator's existing slot names. Orange replaces blue/teal/gold; black replaces navy. Green and red are kept for trend arrows (universal semantic meaning).

primary.use: Body text, headings (use Calibri as docx fallback)

icons._note: Tech-stack capability icons — use only when illustrating Macronimous's services/stack (proposals, capability slides). Do not use in standard SEO reports or correspondence.
